description: This file defines a custom Presenter for video items in a Leanback-based Android TV application. It manages the creation, binding, and unbinding of image cards that display video titles and descriptions.

classes.name: VideoCardPresenter
classes.description: A Presenter subclass for displaying video items as image cards with title and description in Leanback Android TV UI.

methods.name: onCreateViewHolder
methods.description: Creates and returns a ViewHolder containing an ImageCardView configured with specific dimensions, focusability, and background color.

methods.name: onBindViewHolder
methods.description: Binds a VideoItem's title and description to the ImageCardView inside the ViewHolder; skips image loading for simplicity.

methods.name: onUnbindViewHolder
methods.description: Clears the main image from the ImageCardView to free resources when unbinding.
